verdict_reason: estimable holdout result clears neither directional threshold

estimate.method: OLS country/year FE with country-clustered standard errors

falsification_rule_text: If fewer than 2,000 complete country-years or 80 distinct countries remain, or the primary coefficient or country-clustered uncertainty is nonfinite or unidentified, INCONCLUSIVE. Otherwise SUPPORTED if the trade-openness coefficient is positive with a two-sided clustered p-value at most 0.01; REFUTED if it is negative with p at most 0.01; every other estimable result is PARTIAL. Nine related trade-openness holdout tests use the same p<=0.01 rule, controlling their family-wise decision error below 0.10 by Bonferroni. The same fixed test counts null and adverse outcomes.
limitations: Associational geographic holdout; no causal trade-policy claim.
The original 40-country PARTIAL result was known before this registration.
GDP per capita and private consumption share income and price drivers; controls do not remove all confounding.
This is one of nine related trade-openness tests with a shared country pool and family-wise threshold.
